title: Model File
content: File Extension: .nif The model files are stored in a Gamebryo format called NetImmerse File format, which can be rendered with a Texture File or as is. These files are also commonly referred to as a Mesh, NIF, or NetImmerse File. Tooling: - Elric - NifSkope - Blender - Autodesk 3ds Max - There are other software projects that provide tooling for working model files. Notes: - The .nif file extension stands for Net Immerse File format. See Also: - Texture File - Material File - Game Files Category - Gamebryo on Wikipedia
